pythonFunction.name: get_shipping_address
pythonFunction.description:
Gets the current shipping address of one order, to read out to the caller before a change. Call it after the caller is verified and has given the order number.

Args:
  order_number: The order number the caller gave, for example "102" or "00000102".

Returns:
  dict: ok and street, city, state, postal_code, country. If error is not_found nothing matched; if system_error is true, apologize and escalate.
